objective: Proof: with counts never below the next round demand the pattern is the rank-truncated order of ideals of its one-parent junctions (Birkhoff); one count for every join survives exactly when it equals the first knot size (stall rounds otherwise), giving the a-fold product of counting chains with bond balls of order r^a; with the cap of three exactly three; the fewest counts close one knot into the 2^a pattern; the distance reader generalised.
title: What the joining policy builds when the count is free
